splice-u.stl.part: Splice U: U1 pocket (18.9 mm), 60 mm long, eight M2.5 captured-nut slots
splice-u.stl.orientation: Standing on one end, tube opening vertical; as exported.

splice-bar.stl.part: Splice bar, 29.75 mm long, four M2.5 holes and head recesses
splice-bar.stl.orientation: Flat, screw-head recesses up; as exported.

estimate.method: Not sliced; the Snapmaker Orca command line crashed with the U1 profiles. Per part: side area x walls x 0.45 mm plus flat area x top/bottom layers x 0.2 mm, capped at the solid volume, plus infill in the rest; PETG at 1.27 g/cm3. Time at an average 6 to 10 mm3/s, as on a fast printer such as the U1.

hardware.use: Each bar to the U, four per bar, into the captured nuts
hardware.check: validate() fits M2.5 screws from 13.9 to 21.8 mm across 18.0 to 18.6 mm tubes

hardware.item: M2.5 hex nut, 5.0 mm across flats, 2.0 mm thick (plain, not nylon-insert)
hardware.use: In the U side slots (5.4 by 2.6 mm)

buy.screws: M2.5 socket-head cap screws, 16 mm (at least 8)
buy.nuts: M2.5 hex nuts, 5.0 mm across flats (at least 8)

interfaces.tube: Square tube of 18.0 to 18.6 mm: 18.9 mm pocket, 0.3 to 0.9 mm of sideways play; each bar takes up its own piece front to back
interfaces.joint: Tube ends butt at z = 30, halfway along the U; bars 0.5 mm apart there

design_guidance.rule: Strength comes mostly from perimeters; most parts need 10 to 15 % infill, rarely over 30 %; gyroid has equal strength in all directions.
design_guidance.change: 6 perimeters, 5 top and bottom layers, 25 % gyroid, as the neck clamp.

design_guidance.rule: Walls thinner than one perimeter (about 0.45 mm) do not print.
design_guidance.change: At least three perimeters (1.35 mm) around every screw feature; see geometry_validation.walls_mm.

design_guidance.rule: Moving fits start at 0.3 mm clearance; vertical holes print undersized.
design_guidance.change: 2.9 mm clearance holes; U1 pocket 18.9 mm with 0.15 to 0.45 mm per side.

design_guidance.rule: Edges on the build plate flare; chamfer them where fit matters. Chamfers rather than fillets facing the bed.
design_guidance.change: 0.5 mm chamfer on the pocket at the bed; rounded corners only on edges vertical as printed.

design_guidance.rule: Overhangs up to 45 degrees print without supports; bridges sag unless shorter than 5 mm.
design_guidance.change: Only 2.9 mm hole tops and 2.6 mm nut-slot tops face down.

design_guidance.rule: FDM parts are weaker between layers; orient structural parts for their load.
design_guidance.change: U prints standing, so screw tension runs along its layers; bending at the joint crosses them (untested).

nut-trap sizes (the neck clamp allowance: 5.4 by 2.6 mm slots for a 5.0 by 2.0 mm nut)
